verdict.rationale: Fellow's marketing claims admins can set organization-wide policies for how meetings are accessed, and that teams control what they share. That is a thin first-party statement of sharing governance with no documented detail. Super Admin API data export and MCP connection governance are adjacent features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented private-by-default notes, granular link/folder/workspace sharing permissions, admin visibility or reporting into what is shared, in-depth docs, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, sharing is controlled — private-by-default notes, granular link/folder/workspace permissions, and admin visibility into what's shared
